item.title: Fly tip of household rubbish, 15th August
item.description:
Persons unknown are fly tipping black bags with household waste, which is being ripped open, resulting in rubbish all over the pavement. This corner seems to be a “hot spot” for fly tipping. Could a camera & some signage be fitted to the lamppost to deter this. I left my house at 1pm and this rubbish was not present, I returned at 2:30 pm and it is strewn all over the pavement and in my Driveway Please action this asap.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Dunkery Road, Mottingham, Greater London
